---
title: "ATU with the DiD adapter"
output: html_document
---

Requires the locally installed `dml.sensemakr` 0.2.2.9012 and `did`.
This illustrates computation on `mpdta`; it does not establish the identifying
assumptions for these data. ATU here targets the selected never-treated counties
if they adopted in 2007. Its causal interpretation requires comparability of
potential changes **under treatment**, not just ordinary ATT parallel trends.

```{r}
library(did)
library(dml.sensemakr)
data(mpdta)

fit <- att_gt(yname = "lemp", tname = "year", idname = "countyreal",
              gname = "first.treat", xformla = ~ lpop, data = mpdta,
              bstrap = FALSE, cband = FALSE, compute_inffunc = FALSE)

m <- dml_from_did(fit, group = 2007, time = 2007,
                  method = "dml_refit", target = "atu",
                  dml_args = list(yreg = "lm", dreg = "glm", d.class = TRUE,
                                  cf.folds = 3, cf.seed = 1))
summary(m)
dml_bounds(m, cf.y = 0.05, cf.d = 0.05)
```

The last line gives bounds for the chosen confounding strengths, under the
corresponding long-model ATU identifying assumption. ATU pre-trend benchmarking
is not implemented; covariate benchmarking is available through `dml_benchmark()`.
